706840101.text: Uh, h—hi everyone...! I'm Sansa, and I'm a... or, well, I'm working on becoming a bard. Uh... Th—Thanks for coming out today, and um... yeah, uh... I guess I'll start the song now...

706840102.text: "All goes quiet on Starsnatch Cliff. High in the trees, all is..." Wait, sorry, that's not right.

706840103.text: "High in the trees, no whiff of the wind, no sign of... the birds, no flapping of wings..." Uh, then it goes... "Pause"... "Pause for a moment, and"...

706840104.text: Oh gosh, this is so embarrassing, I'm making a complete mess of this... I didn't get tongue-tied at all on the forty-second time or the ninetieth time, so why can't I get it right now?

706840106.text: Yep! I rehearsed this a hundred times to try and perfect my performance. So this is my one-hundred-and-first time playing this song, but my first time performing it live...

706840107.text: *sigh* I really thought it would go well this time, but nope — I blew it again. Though not for lack of practice, surely... I guess I need to figure out what I was doing right on my forty-second and ninetieth attempts, and keep practicing...

706840110.text: Right! That amount of practice should have been more than enough. If it still isn't working... Maybe it's more a question of how you've been practicing?

706840111.text: #Actually, {NICKNAME} here has loads of experience with performing music. Why don't you tell us what your method is? Maybe we can give you some suggestions!

706840201.text: Please take this collection of sheet music.

706840203.text: If you want to try out different instruments, feel free to come find me any time.

706849901.text: That's quite a crowd over there. Is someone doing a performance? Let's go see!
